name: Crawling Sensation
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [mind-affecting]; Level adept 2, bard 2, druid 2, mesmerist 2, psychic 2, sorcerer/wizard 2, witch 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, M (the shell of a beetle)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw Will partial; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You cause your target to believe that they can feel multitudess of tiny insects crawling and biting all over. The target may attempt a Will save each round to ignore the sensation for that round. A success means they may act normally. A failure means they take a -2 penalty AC and can only move at half speed for that round. In addition the creature must also make a concentration check to cast spells with DC 11 + the caster level of the crawling sensation spell or lose the spell.
